evidence: decorative_mascot: A second identical Data is parked bottom-center in the SAME clipboard/arm-out pose in every frame from hook@0.3 through payoff@-0.4 (42s), never moving or acting — a static sticker duplicated over the whole video.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: At seg2:start and seg2:mid the right-hand annotations run off the frame: 'Properly recycled  22'' loses its percent sign and 'Not properly recycled' reads 'Not properly recycle'. These two labels ARE the scene's claim (only 22% recycled) and a phone viewer cannot read either. The section kicker 'NOT PROPERLY RECYCLED IS 78% OF THE WHOLE' also runs to the very edge.
weakest_scene.root_cause: Label text is placed at a fixed x offset to the right of the bar with no measured width check against the frame's safe area, so long series names ('Not properly recycled', 'Met by e-waste recycling') overflow the 1080px width instead of wrapping, shrinking, or moving inside the column.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Measure each annotation's rendered width and keep it fully inside the safe area — right-align the label stack to a margin, wrap or abbreviate long series names, and place the value ('22%', '78%') adjacent to its own segment so both the name and the number are legible at arm's length.
